description: TypeScript HDL: design digital circuits with type-checked ports, simulate them in the browser or Node, verify them with property-based tests, and export Verilog for FPGAs.
rules: Import circuit, bit and bus from '@simten/core/circuit', and standard components from '@simten/core/std'.
Export the top-level circuit from each module.
Use singleton components bare (nodes: { g: And }) and call parameterized ones (Register({ width: 16 }), or Register() for defaults).
In connect, wire a circuit's own inputs and outputs directly (a.to(x.a), x.out.to(result)); node ports use their port names (x.out, x.a).
A simulation run shows what a circuit does, not that it is correct. Check correctness with @simten/core/verify, declaring an oracle with declareOracle.
